kurz: Part of the batter has not baked through or has collapsed again. The starch has not [[staerkeverkleisterung|gelatinised]] properly.
bild_im_kopf: Like pudding in a cake coat.

ursachen.warum: The centre does not reach the temperature at which starch sets.
fix: Bake longer; cover with foil if the top gets too dark

ursachen.warum: Juicy fruit releases water and makes the batter underneath wet.
fix: Pat fruit dry and toss it in a little flour

q1.frage: Was there fruit or a lot of liquid in the batter?

q2.frage: Was the top already dark when you took it out?
